comment: Model files the edge backend ships with, and the only ones it may use. Verified by app/services/preflight.py at startup and restored by scripts/fetch_models.py (which also deletes ONNX files in models/ that are not listed here). Each model is downloaded from its upstream publisher; a 'transform' block rebuilds it with a script of this repository. If a rebuild is not byte-identical, fetch_models accepts it when its ONNX IO signature matches 'io' and records its hash in models/.local_exports.json.
licence_note: Every model listed here is Apache-2.0 (OpenMMLab mmpose; code and weights): RTMO (rtmo-*.onnx, https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/tree/main/projects/rtmo) and RTMPose (rtmpose-*.onnx, https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/tree/main/projects/rtmpose). Both checkpoints were trained on the body7 mix, which includes datasets published for research use only; whether that affects commercial use of the weights is pending a legal check (see each entry's 'weights'). No AGPL-3.0 or non-commercial model may be added. Attribution: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at the repository root.

models.role: Person + 17 COCO keypoints (one-stage RTMO-s, mmpose): the live person model on every provider (POSE_MODEL_GPU / POSE_MODEL_CPU). Static [1,3,640,640] graph with the in-graph NMS removed: the host applies score threshold + NMS (inference_backend.decode_output, layout 'rtmo').

transform.method: ONNX graph surgery on the released end2end.onnx: batch fixed to 1; the NonMaxSuppression + TopK(50) index tensor replaced by a constant TopK(k=300) over the 2000 anchor scores; NMS subgraph pruned; shape arithmetic constant-folded. Verified identical (before host NMS) to the original on 8 images: boxes within 0.0002 px, keypoints within 0.0005 px, scores within 2e-6.

weights.training_data: body7 (COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18)
weights.note: Some body7 datasets are published for research use only; commercial use is pending a legal check. A COCO-only checkpoint exists (rtmo-s_8xb32-600e_coco-640x640-8db55a59_20231211.pth, about 1 AP lower) but OpenMMLab publishes no ONNX for it; exporting it needs mmpose + mmdeploy. The file is swappable: POSE_MODEL_PATH (or POSE_MODEL_GPU/_CPU) names any RTMO export with the same IO.

preprocess.input: BGR, float 0-255, no mean/std (none in the graph)

postprocess.host: score threshold + greedy NMS + box/keypoint letterbox undo (inference_backend.decode_output / PersonDetector.postprocess, layout 'rtmo')
postprocess.original_in_graph: score > 0.15, NMS suppress IoU > 0.65, max 200, keep top 50

models.licence: Apache-2.0 (OpenMMLab mmpose / RTMO; weights trained on the body7 mix)

models.role: Optional top-down keypoint refiner (POSE_REFINER): RTMPose-s SimCC, one 256x192 crop per person; re-estimates the keypoints of each detected person.
models.licence: Apache-2.0 (OpenMMLab mmpose / RTMPose; weights trained on the body7 mix)

weights.training_data: body7 (COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18)
weights.note: Some body7 datasets are published for research use only; commercial use is pending a legal check.
